_: THE DOCS SITE'S MAP. One entry per rail page, in rail order; `file` is the markdown under docs/site/ and `slug` is the URL under /docs/. The `##` headings inside each file become that page's rail sub-entries, its anchors and its search crumbs at once - nothing is listed twice. `generated` names a block the build writes from another file in the repo, so that page cannot drift from the code (settings: taskuary/settings_schema.json). Build with `npm run build:docs` in website/; CI fails if site/docs is not what a fresh build produces.
